title: synthetic-data-learning
summary: A personal learning project of Jupyter notebooks exploring synthetic data generation on a bank dataset, comparing CTGAN and TVAE approaches with quality evaluation. It runs SDV's SingleTableMetadata, CTGANSynthesizer, and evaluate_quality functions directly to generate and assess synthetic tabular data.
